description: This file defines a Roslyn analyzer for C# that checks the correct usage of certain attributes on classes related to Orleans grains. It reports diagnostics if specific attributes are used improperly.

classes.name: IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer for detecting incorrect attribute usage on Orleans grain classes.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Checks class declarations to verify if they inherit from a grain class and contain specific attributes, then reports diagnostics.

methods.name: TryReportFor
methods.description: Reports a diagnostic if the specified attribute is present on the class declaration.
